newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CONMED cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CONMED cut to buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analysts Kevin Kotler, Samuel Navarro and Joanne Wuensch Friday downgraded their rating for CONMED Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- "We believe CNMD's sales force reorganization during 1Q97 could result in an EPS shortfall of around $0.06, resulting in an EPS of approximately $0.25," they wrote in a report.
-- "... We are changing our rating ... just to reflect the near-term uncertainty" about the first quarter shortfall and uncertainty about near-term acquisitions.
-- The analysts cut their 1997 estimate for earnings per share to $1.29 from $1.43 and to $1.50 from $1.75 for 1998.
-- Shares in the Utica, N.Y., electrosurgical systems maker were up 1/8 to 14-3/8.
